repos_data.description: Cross-platform GUI written in Rust using ADB to debloat non-rooted Android devices. Improve your privacy, the security and battery life of your device.
Open source device layer for AI coding agents: a CLI, MCP server, and typed Node.js API to control mobile, web, TV, and desktop apps on devices and simulators, locally or in the cloud.
Control your Android devices with AI using Model Context Protocol
Android and iOS devices, side by side on your Mac. Mirror, control, change settings and capture — free and open source.
Bash script to export android content providers data to csv

Free ADB GUI and Android Emulator control panel for macOS. One click for dark mode, font scale, RTL and pseudo-locales, TalkBack, layout bounds, network speed and GPS: no adb commands. Layout Inspector in dp for any app (Compose and Views) with Figma overlay and TalkBack-order audit. Plus an MCP server for AI agents.
Agent Droid Bridge gives AI agents programmatic control over Android devices and emulators via ADB, exposed as an MCP server.

MCP server for Android — drive emulators and real devices over adb from Claude Code, Cursor, or VS Code. 73 tools: screenshots, UI hierarchy, tap/swipe/type, logcat, device locks, Gradle builds and tests. The Android counterpart to XcodeBuildMCP.
MCP server that lets AI assistants (Claude, OpenCode, VS Code) control Android devices securely via ADB
